parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of tearDown being executed on skipped tests when running with --pdb. The changes are minimal and focused on the problem.

issues.description: The function _is_skipped is added, which could be considered a minor maintainability issue as it introduces a new function that is only used in one place.
